notes.title: Super Dirt Racers Early Access and DLC updates
notes.content:
Both Early Access and DLC versions have had several updates and new features including...


 Time Trial mode
 Quick Race Mode
 League Mode
 Rear View Camera
 First Person View
 Better AI
 On Track Gantries
 Water will now slow you down


Thank you for playing Super Dirt Racers.

notes.title: Super Dirt Racers Linux DLC Available Now!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=y-XTQu4b4rc;full][/previewyoutube]

This DLC transforms the original early access title to include various new features.

Race over unique terrain and finish in the top 3 to unlock new cars and tracks.

Pick up nitro canisters but use them wisely to beat your rivals.

Pick up carrots for a 'mystery feature'.


Features:

 Improved vehicle handling.
 11 Unique tracks to race on.
 10 Iconic vehicles to choose from.
 Up to 9 AI opponents in quick race mode. 
 Compete in 18 tracks to finish championship mode.
 Try to beat your best track times in time trial mode.

notes.title: Mini update
notes.content:
...Sorry its's been a while...


 Small AI patches (AI should be slightly less crazy - only slightly though)
 Replaced the BIG BANG sound with something else (that is probably just as annoying)



Hopefully a MUCH BIGGER update will be coming in the future.

notes.title: Update Notes for Early Access v0.66
notes.content:
1. Re-enabled mouse support on menu.
2. Enable use of ESC key during game to pause game.
3. Levelled out sound effects.
4. Added new camera angles.
5. Tweaked car stability.
6. Added new engine sounds.
7. Added menu music.
